name: Golf Ball
summary: White urethane golf ball with 362 geometric dimples in an icosahedral layout.
dimensions: 42.67 mm circumscribed cover diameter, explicitly requested at the R&A/USGA minimum rather than a range midpoint. [R&A Equipment Rules, Part 4](https://www.randa.org/en/roe/the-rules-of-equipment/part-4-conformance-of-balls).
construction: Frequency-six subdivision of an icosahedron gives 362 symmetric dimple centres. The dual cells carry circular inset rings, with approximately 0.28 mm bowl depth; cell borders are welded into an editable cover. No texture is needed for the visible dimples.
accuracy_notes: The 42.67 mm design envelope is measured at the outer land vertices. Dimples and tessellation reduce the axis extents by up to 0.2 mm. The mesh is translated by its lowest vertex so the floor datum is exact. Original dimple layout approximates a manufactured urethane cover; aerodynamic performance and conformity are not certified.
